units.source_text: 这时，混乱越来越严重了。

en.t: By this time, the chaos was growing more and more serious.

units.source_text: 库拉巴喀仍旧面对钢琴坐在那里，傲慢地掉过头转头望向我们。

en.t: Kurabaka was still sitting there facing the piano, and he turned his head arrogantly to look at us.

units.source_text: 无论他多傲慢，也得时刻躲闪那些飞过来的东西。

en.t: However arrogant he was, he still had to keep dodging the things that came flying at him.

units.source_text: 换句话说，每隔两三秒钟他就得改变自己姿势。

en.t: In other words, every two or three seconds he had to change his posture.

units.source_text: 不过他还是大体保持了大音乐家的威严，他的眯缝眼儿炯炯有神。

en.t: Even so, he more or less preserved the dignity of a great musician, and his narrowed eyes shone brightly.

units.source_text: 至于我——为了避开风险，一直躲在托喀身后。

en.t: As for me, to keep out of danger, I stayed hidden behind Tokka the whole time.

units.source_text: 可是好奇心让我和马咯谈论充满热情：“难道这样的检查不显得太野蛮了吗？”

en.t: But curiosity made me speak with Maro in great excitement: "Doesn't this kind of examination seem far too barbaric?"
